Docs.summary:
Provides and caches session tokens used to authenticate eligible blob requests.
A owns the session cache and the machinery used to mint sessions. It can be shared across multiple clients (via ) so that independently created clients reuse a single cache instead of each creating their own, avoiding redundant create-session requests.
This type has a closed hierarchy: it can be referenced but not derived from outside of the SDK. Use for token-credential based sessions.
